235256341_8b4a55a2.text: Orexin-A and -B are excitatory neuropeptides synthesized in the lateral hypothalamus and perifornical areas (Lecea et al., 1998) (Sakurai et al., 1998). Orexin-A is composed of 33 amino acids, while orexin-B is composed of 28 amino acids; both are derived from the same precursor (prepro-orexin) by proteolytic processing (Lecea et al., 1998)(Sakurai et al., 1998). The activity of orexin-A and -B are mediated by Gprotein-coupled orexin receptors: OX 1 R and OX 2 R; OX 1 R has a higher affinity for orexin-A than orexin-B, while OX 2 R binds both orexins with the same affinity (Xu et al., 2013)

235256341_6c1c4a67.text: .More specifically, orexins regulate sleep and wake via dense projections from orexin neurons in the lateral hypothalamus that innervate and activate serotonergic neurons in the DR [17], noradrenergic neurons in the LC [18], and histaminergic neurons in the TMN [19].
